source: master_runs_76.csv + posthoc_score_backfill_76_compact.csv + 36 SHA-verified raw archive members
limitations: Two large ZIPs (40 records) returned no binary content from connector; do NOT call those centers measured

reason_legend.center_from_verified_member: recomputed from 3x3 Train center in SHA-verified original member; canonical Chapter-3 formula
reason_legend.source_center_unavailable: original member ZIP was not retrievable as bytes in this session; center not inspected
reason_legend.raw_member_verified: actual raw checkpoint ZIP/member SHA-256 and manifest matched
reason_legend.master_csv_only: value reported by master_runs_76.csv; member bytes NOT independently checked in this mission
reason_legend.posthoc_csv: value reported in posthoc_score_backfill_76_compact.csv; no new inference; posthoc diagnostic, not training objective
reason_legend.posthoc_tau005: posthoc Softplus uses tau=0.005 regardless of objective training tau
reason_legend.legacy_R_KL_clipped: original R_KL uses q.clamp_min(1e-300); does NOT independently certify exact-support-aware Chapter-3 KL
reason_legend.KL_exact_unverified: no per-sample representations/candidate distances checked under exact support-aware KL
reason_legend.query_start_undefined: node/node_class lack trained out-of-graph query-start policy; Validation is not applicable, NOT zero
reason_legend.raw_metric_needs_unavailable_member: historical JSON likely contains this metric; member bytes unavailable, NOT independently verified
reason_legend.requires_per_sample_scores: not saved in the accessible historical summaries; requires sample-level scores/inference-only replay
reason_legend.raw_legacy_margin: legacy raw metric stored under its original name; do not reinterpret as a new trained metric
reason_legend.not_in_compact_csv: not available in current flat CSV; no invented values
reason_legend.from_verified_raw_center: center geometry from verified original archive, with Chapter-3 canonical calculations
reason_legend.verified_positive_center_support: All components of every class center strictly positive (>1e-300); no p>0,q=0 can occur for a valid distribution, for this exact stored center set. Original KL numeric retained; no per-sample KL recomputation.
